transcription.final_text: The patient has been complaining of bilateral knee pain for five years. The pain increased two years ago. A plain x-ray showed advanced grade four osteoarthritis. Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs were given for approximately one month along with muscle relaxants, resulting in mild improvement. She is now doing physiotherapy exercises and is scheduled for a follow-up in two weeks.
